purpose: Teach: 宗派/聖霊/自明/恒久/不平等/伝導/消失/垣間見

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の宗派を尊重しろ
lines.en: Our company must respect our employees' religious observances.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Each clause lands with clear weight. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. No rush, no softness—this is a directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。聖霊降臨祭のお休みも考慮します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we account for religious holidays like Pentecost.
lines.style: Attentive, taking mental note. Slight nod built into the delivery. Warm but professional—showing he's heard and will act. Brief pause before the second clause, as if writing it down internally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、品質基準を自明にしろ
lines.en: Our company's quality standards must be transparent to everyone.
lines.style: Firm, strategic. Each word precisely placed. Leans forward slightly on 'standards.' The voice of someone setting expectation, not suggesting it. Unambiguous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。恒久的な雇用制度を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll establish a stable, permanent employment structure.
lines.style: Dutiful, grounded. Speaks with the tone of someone committing to concrete action. Slower pace on 'permanent'—emphasizing the weight of that promise. Genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員間の不平等を排除しろ
lines.en: We must eliminate inequality among our staff.
lines.style: Sharp, non-negotiable. Slight edge on 'eliminate'—this is not optional. The voice hardens just enough to make clear this is a moral position, not a preference. Breath steady, gaze steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電気伝導素材の研究を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll advance our research into sustainable materials and practices.
lines.style: Engaged, forward-thinking. A touch lighter than previous—this is hopeful work. Slight lift at 'research,' as if imagining the outcome. Still professional, but the warmth shows through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不良在庫の消失目標を立てろ
lines.en: Our company will set a clear target for reducing defective inventory.
lines.style: Strategic, measured. Speaks as someone setting a concrete goal with confidence. Level tone, no inflection wasted. 'Target' lands with quiet authority. The voice of someone who tracks progress.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の表情に垣間見える疲れにも気付きます
lines.en: Yes. And I'll pay closer attention to how exhaustion shows on our people's faces.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. A shift—less formal, more human. Slight pause before 'faces,' as if he's just noticed something himself. Gentle, but carries the weight of genuine care. Almost to himself.
